scope: Read-only lifecycle correctness audit plus a new large-delta query integration test. No runtime/algorithm edits and no host operations. The tested view is the unpruned delta implementation before the root-coordinated performance change.

new_test.name: large_tied_delta_merges_with_native_base_and_reports_all_matching_candidates
new_test.k_cases: Includes top-k boundaries with repeated exact-distance ties and k larger than total matching records.
new_test.oracle: Independent integer squared-L2 plus stable-ID full sort; compare returned f32 distances without integer truncation, ordered IDs, result length, current sequence, and per-hit label membership. Native breadth exhausts the small base postings to avoid assuming ANN recall.
new_test.accounting: delta_candidates must equal all matching delta records, including records discarded before final merging.
new_test.snapshot_check: The pre-update snapshot retains its base record and has no fresh-label results after the newer batch is published.

read_only_audit.finding: No additional concrete functional bug found in the requested paths.
checks: apply stages an immutable complete batch, fsyncs its journal frame, then publishes the ArcSwap view
recovery replays contiguous complete frames beyond the manifest base sequence and validates the stable-ID allocation watermark
compaction captures one snapshot, rebuilds outside the writer lock, replays catch-up under the writer lock, commits CURRENT, publishes the matching view, and only then checkpoints WAL history
CURRENT/checkpoint failure cuts retain journal coverage for either durable generation and poison uncertain writers
automatic IDs use the durable watermark, including after deletion and empty-base compaction
retired and rejected-but-leased generations retain Weak/Base lease tracking; Base holds GenerationStore so another writer cannot reclaim live snapshot files
shadowed base labels and conservative exact-cutoff handling avoid the known far-delta premature-stop case
read_only_audit.low_level_scope_note: GenerationStore::read_current is metadata/verification access without a reader lease. FilteredSnapshot is the leased query API; the root agreed only a documentation clarification is appropriate, with no new public API.

performance_claim: No performance result is attached. The root is measuring the unpruned hot-delta baseline before deciding whether to retain only exact delta top-k prior to merging.
